svg.title: Job methods are built from a few shared pieces
svg.desc: Matrix computed from scheduler.cpp: which job methods each Plan<Type>Job calls, which events it creates itself, and which edge rules it applies itself.
svg.metadata: ["The thirteen job methods, one per row. Eleven implement a job type; PlanOpenBayDoor and PlanUnstashWaypointTraysJob are helpers that other methods call.", "Calls: which other job methods and helpers each method calls directly. Composite jobs pass their own job_index down, so the callee's events belong to the caller's job.", "Creates directly: which event types a method constructs itself with make_shared<...>. Many methods create no TrayMove themselves; they get one from a callee.", "Edge rules: whether a method applies rule A (UpdateLastEntityEvent) or rule B (UpdateLeafDependencies) itself rather than through a callee.", "PlanReparkTrayJob is the workhorse: 6 other methods create their TrayMoves through it, so rule C, the heading policy and the VECS checks live in one place."]

g.text: Read a row to see what one job method does itself and what it delegates. PlanReparkTrayJob is the workhorse: six other methods create their TrayMoves through it, so rule C and the heading policy live in one place.
